description: Source-only physical-dynamics lexical bridge families for broad runs.
notes: This file is imported by broad physical-dynamics configs; it is not meant as a standalone generation target.
Bridge examples keep target process words close to diagnostic evidence phrases while remaining object-agnostic and scenario-based.
The goal is to support distributional learning for physical-dynamics terms without turning the whole broad corpus into benchmark-style templates.
